thread:
elaine: Quick check — postlaunch CTA heatmap looks odd on /features; CTAs pointing at /pricing-old. Can someone run a redirect + canonical sanity and confirm webinar reg flow? Need fixes before Monday. :eyes:

maria: on it. saw a few 302s from old redirects, will convert to 301s. also noticed missing schema on /pricing (Event schema for webinar CTA).

sam: I can do redirect rules. Proposed nginx snippet:
```
location = /pricing-old { return 301 /pricing; }
``` 
will roll in staging.

jonah: I’ll run a quick crawl + heatmap overlay. running Screaming Frog then GA heatmap export. ETA 30m.

maria: schema patch — adding JSON-LD for Event and Speakable sections. sample snippet:
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood launch webinar","startDate":"2026-04-01T16:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.com/webinar"}
```
I’ll PR.

elaine: @sam @maria TY. Two asks: make redirects canonical 301, add link rel=canonical on /pricing-old -> /pricing, and ensure webinar CTAs use UTM campaign 'launch_apr'. Also set internal link from /blog/launch to /webinar as primary. :thumbsup: 

sam: noted. nginx + canonical header in next deploy.

seo-bot: sitemap.xml updated (auto). 1 new URL added: /webinar

jonah: crawl done. Found 6 internal links pointing at /pricing-old (blog, FAQ, footer). I'll drop a small PR to update anchors.

maria: PR for JSON-LD and canonical in staging: https://github.com/redwood-inference/site/pull/321

elaine: perfect. once all merged, can we run GA funnel smoke and verify conversion event fires? If yes, we publish changes and update the redirect monitoring alert.

sam: will add a synthetic check hitting CTAs with utm and verifying event. I'll push to infra pipeline.

jonah: heatmap shows CTA CTR bumped 12% after changes on staging preview. re-check post-merge.

elaine: excellent. label this thread 'launch-seo-postlaunch' in case we need to find later. :rocket:

maria: done, closing loop. any followups?

sam: none from infra side.

jonah: none. :raised_hands:
